notes: Applies a retry rule to a test class through a new @Rule RetryRule field and marks the test with @Retry, without changing either type. Kept: the import, field and annotation hunks of one of the three test classes of the PR used in reject-junit4-retry-rule-with-annotation; the tearDown hunk that clears a schema list is dropped. In the PR the rule and the annotation are new files; they are not in this patch, so the checker meets the same situation as when a project already has the rule: a type it does not read. Rejected with retry/existing_retry_extension, because the simple names RetryRule and Retry contain Retry. As kept, the patch would not build, since neither type exists in the pre image.
